audit.canonical_shape_hash_method: SHA256 of UTF-8 JSON sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False; all shapes of frame sorted by integer id.
audit.coverage_limit: All 150 frames were inventoried for recognizable instances in all seven classes. Prior source/overlay reviews were reused with exact bindings; seven final saved composites were actually sampled. This is practical coverage and structural verification, not a measured IoU, precision, recall, or quantified accuracy claim.
